Web · Merchant Tools · Creator Tools

Spin for Web

Web experiences for consumers, merchants and influencers, plus a merchant and creator operations hub.

Project typeWeb + B2B Product
ContributionCreative Direction, UI/UX Design
Year2020
CompanySpin

01 · Marketing website

Spin Live Website

The Challenge

Design a website that is used by three very specific audiences. Spin is a native app that influencers use to create content about products they know and love. Merchants provide products and deals for influencers to create content around. And finally, consumers use the app to browse and purchase these products.

Each one of these constituents needed a location on the site that was tailored for them with clear calls to action.

My Role

  • Creative Direction
  • UI/UX Design

02 · Operations platform

Spin Live Merchant & Influencer Hub

The Challenge

Build an onboarding portal that allows merchants to upload their products, create offers from those products and, finally, build a live stream with those offers.

We also needed to build a sister hub for influencers that gave them access to offers provided by merchants and allowed them to build a live stream from those offers.

The final piece was a live stream control panel that shows real-time shopping data, audience interaction and the ability to navigate offers.

My Role

  • Creative Direction
  • UI/UX Design

03 · Solution

My Solution

I used Etsy’s Shop Manager as a source of inspiration for this challenge. The entire onboarding process had many moving parts and required quite a bit of data entry, so my solution broke down the flow into small, consumable sections. Once a user completes a section, they seamlessly move to the next with clear instructions along the way. I also ensured that we pre-populated as many fields as possible, offered tooltips and suggested values to ease the workflow.
